assessments.reasoning: The exact Apple DocC object has an MTLLanguageVersion title and an abstract identifying its subject as versions of Metal shading language.

challenge.method: Compare the DocC metadata and abstract with the publisher name, title, and document scope on physical pages 1 and 12 of the Apple PDF.
challenge.results: The DocC title names an API enumeration. Its abstract and the separate language-specification title establish the narrower language referent.

limitations: The finding concerns the language referent documented in this snapshot. Device, compiler, and SDK support require separate evidence.
